resources.string: Control the TV from Telegram: the TV\'s own Telegram bot takes commands from the people its owner allows (remote keys, typing, Quick channel, YouTube, apps, typed requests like voice, links, photos / videos, Timer, Kids lock, Refresh, turn off / restart). It only knows which app just appeared, to report status; it doesn\'t read the screen or catch remote keys.
Tele Remote: the TV is asking \"Allow debugging?\". Choose Always allow, then OK, so the TV can be controlled from Telegram.
